description: This file defines the DatabaseShellConfigurationSources class, which implements IShellConfigurationSources to manage shell configuration data stored in a database, including methods for adding, saving, removing, and migrating configurations.

classes.name: DatabaseShellConfigurationSources
classes.description: Implements IShellConfigurationSources to handle shell configuration data stored in a database, with methods for adding, saving, removing, and migrating configurations.

methods.name: DatabaseShellConfigurationSources
methods.description: Constructor that initializes options, shell context factory, and container path based on configuration and shell options.

methods.name: AddSourcesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds shell configuration sources for a given tenant by retrieving or migrating configuration data from the database or file.

methods.name: SaveAsync
methods.description: Saves or updates configuration data for a specified tenant in the database.

methods.name: RemoveAsync
methods.description: Removes configuration data for a specified tenant from the database.

methods.name: TryMigrateFromFileAsync
methods.description: Attempts to migrate configuration data from a file for a given tenant; returns true if successful.
